evidence.R1-01: round0 row 101 (second CO-A2 unanswered) goes straight to 'not known' + CO-A4 with no re-read, against packet R3 Q4 're-read the order. Cancelled, continue to refund ... Re-read fails, ... hand off'; row 100 also lacks an order-absent branch (cockburn-checklist.md line 74).
evidence.R1-02: round0 CO-S17 row 3 injects OrderNotCancelled right after CO-A2 returned cancelled (final state 'HG-10482 has status cancelled'); CO-S24 injects OrderNotFound for an order Initial state says 'belongs to the customer' and CO-A1 returned.
evidence.R1-03: Part (a) is answered by G-03 'Otherwise it tells the customer the action was not done', but part (b) stands: packet R3 Q3 says 'failed or no refund, hand off and say the refund is not confirmed yet', while round0 row 105, CO-S20 step 10 and 'Refund not issued reported' require 'the refund has not been issued'.
evidence.R1-04: round0 CO-08 'the agent tells the customer the refund id' and message check 'Refund id reported' (8 scenarios); the packet asks only 'Final message must match the final refund status' / 'pending or issued, report that status', and the confirmed derivations do not include the refund id.
evidence.R1-05: round0 Appendix A CO-A3 return adds 'failure_reason (payment_method_closed, payment_method_expired or declined)' and drops order_number; the packet's confirmed refund fields are 'refund id, order number, amount, payment method, status'. This is an invented field, not wording.
evidence.R1-06: round0 line 49 'promise a date by which the refunded money arrives' is narrower than the confirmed packet R3 Q1 'The agent promises nothing about when the money arrives'.
evidence.R1-07: In round0, no G-/CO- rule and no §5.2 dimension forbids a timing promise; it appears only as Scope must-not line 49.
evidence.R1-08: round0 G-04 allows a repeat when 'the order system guarantees that repeating it creates nothing new (Appendix B, SG-01)'; SG-04 makes that cover a blind CO-A2 resend that packet R3 Q4 forbids ('no blind resend'), and row 106 relies on SG-03 while citing G-04. This is rule content, not wording.
evidence.R1-09: round0 CO-S17/CO-S20 column '<refund final state>' holds whole lines of different form ('Exactly one refund exists ... failed' vs 'No refund exists'), contrary to SKILL.md line 114 'the lines differ only in the values their <column> placeholders take'.
evidence.R1-10: round0 CO-S06 'Illustrates CO-01, CO-05': the order is already cancelled, so CO-05 ('CO-A3 occurs only for an order ... a lookup shows cancelled') would permit a refund and is not what holds one back.
evidence.R1-11: round0 row 89 fires on 'a lookup ... [that] did not answer', while CO-01 holds back only 'When no lookup ... has answered' and Appendix A says 'may repeat CO-A1 without limit'.
evidence.R1-12: round0 CO-S02 has no dimension, Forbidden line or scope marker that orders the proposal after the which-order answer; recall is 'never folded into the score' (§5.2), so a guessed HG-10511 proposal that matches the confirmation pair passes rows 1 and 3.
evidence.R1-13: round0 row 96 covers a change 'in the confirming turn or after confirming', but CO-S03's Turn 2 comes 'in place of a confirmation' and no scenario has a change inside a confirming turn.
evidence.R1-14: round0 CO-S19/S20/S21 Initial state 'The order system does not answer the agent's first or second CO-A3, and together they create refund RF-5531' does not say which call creates it, so a CO-A1 between the two calls has no defined result.
evidence.R1-16: round0 §5.1 ends a trial only on an agent message or the 12-message cap, and 'text sent alongside a tool call is not one'; Appendix A allows unlimited CO-A1, and CO-S10/S14/S15/S21 time out every CO-A1, so a looping agent's trial never ends.
evidence.R1-17: round0 CO-S03/CO-S04 Turn 2 trigger 'the agent's first question that proposes cancelling HG-10482' is not a §5.1-defined event (evaluation-checklist.md line 39), and in CO-S03 the only confirmation pair is for HG-10511.
evidence.R1-18: round0 CO-07 ties the statement to 'once the order system has created the task', but dimensions 'Refund not issued reported' and 'Cancellation outcome unknown reported' check only content, and the rubric judge reads text sent alongside tool calls.
evidence.R2-01: round1 CO-S15 Initial state scripts 'does not answer any CO-A1 the agent makes after its second CO-A2', yet the reference trajectory goes 7 CO-A2 -> 8 CO-A4 with no lookup and Forbidden has no 'CO-A4 before a CO-A1', despite revised row 104.
evidence.R2-02: Packet R3 Q3 says 'after the retry the agent re-reads the refund record: ... failed or no refund, ... say the refund is not confirmed yet'; round1 rows 106/107 cover an answered failed or unavailable retry after a timed-out first CO-A3 with no re-read and 'the refund has not been issued'.
evidence.R2-03: round1 dimension 'Refund not confirmed reported' requires 'the refund is not confirmed yet', while G-03 requires 'the action was not done' when the agent can tell (the CO-S20 lookup answers), and a separate 'Refund not issued reported' dimension exists, so judges can split.
evidence.R2-04: round1 Appendix A CO-A3 returns '{refund_id, order_number, amount, payment_method, status}' with no reason field, but CO-S17 step 6 (and CO-S22/S23) shows the tool result 'refund RF-5531, failed, card closed'.
evidence.R2-05: round1 CO-03 requires both 'only the whole order can be cancelled' and 'the refund is the total paid...' for every trigger; 'Whole order only explained' and 'Refund terms explained' each check one statement, and no CO-S09 row (Mastercard, store credit, PayPal) has a different-amount trigger.
evidence.R2-06: round1 CO-07 'When the order is cancelled but its refund is not shown pending or issued ... makes CO-A4' conflicts with the packet's 'An already cancelled order: the agent reports that and changes nothing'; CO-S06 gives only issued refunds, so no scenario covers a null or failed refund.
evidence.R2-07: round1 'Refund status unknown reported' (line 1523) lacks the clause 'saying staff will follow up only in a message sent after the order system returned the follow-up task' that lines 1519-1521 carry.
evidence.R2-08: round1 CO-02's not-found clause applies only 'When the customer names an order number'; no row covers an order described by item or date that matches none of the customer's orders (cockburn-checklist.md line 74, every lookup result).
evidence.R2-09: round1 'Order asked before proposing' says 'states no proposal for either order' without defining 'proposal', while Scope line 37 lets the agent 'tell the customer ... what the refund would be'.
evidence.R2-10: round1 'Shipped order explained' requires 'was not cancelled', but CO-S05's rule CO-01, row 95 and Unambiguity note say 'cannot be cancelled'; evaluation-checklist.md says 'A shared rubric dimension has one definition ... must hold in every one'.
evidence.R2-11: round1 CO-S19 Forbidden 'Fewer than one CO-A1 after the second CO-A3' has no window, and 'Refund status reported' has no timing clause, so a guessed 'pending' stated before the lookup passes row 1.
evidence.R3-01: round2 row 96 now says 'whatever its refund shows ... hand off nothing' and CO-S06 forbids CO-A4, but CO-07 (line 80), §2 'wants every order whose refund is unfinished ... handed to it' and §1 are unchanged, and CO-S06 lists 'Illustrates CO-01, CO-07'.
evidence.R3-03: In round2, only CO-S19's 'Refund status reported' checks the reported status; CO-S01/02/03/09/12/13/16, where CO-A3 returns pending directly, check only 'Refund id reported', so saying 'issued' passes despite G-03 and the packet's 'Final message must match the final refund status'.
evidence.R3-04: round2 row 97 'propose nothing until the customer asks to cancel the whole order' has only its holding-back scenario: CO-S08's only pair is 'No, I'll keep it. (optional)' and CO-A2/CO-A3 are forbidden. No scenario has the acting direction.
evidence.R3-05: round2 row 106 excludes cases where 'an earlier CO-A3 went unanswered', and row 108 lists only 'refund failed or the payment provider temporarily unavailable', so a first CO-A3 unanswered followed by an OrderNotCancelled retry falls in no row.
evidence.R3-06: round2 row 110 applies to all three handoff reasons, but only CO-S23 (refund not issued) exercises it, and 'Staff contact unconfirmed reported' hard-codes 'tells the customer the order is cancelled, the refund has not been issued'.
evidence.R3-07: round2 dimensions (lines 1526-1528, 1530) say 'only in a message sent after ...', while §5.1 says 'text sent alongside a tool call is not one [a message]' and the judge reads such text; 'Refund status reported' uses 'any text', so judges can split.
evidence.R3-08: round2 'Refund terms explained' ('tells the customer the refund is the order's total paid and goes to the order's payment method') is met by the confirmation question itself ('refund $86.40 to Visa ending 4242'), so a run that silently ignores the Mastercard request splits judges.
evidence.R3-09: round2 §5.1 Turn anchors defines 'the user's confirmation turn' only when one occurs ('If a trial has more than one confirmation turn ... the first'), so 'CO-A2 before the user's confirmation turn' has no defined reading in a trial with none.
